svg.title: Prompt caching break-even: a write is repaid at 1.28 reuses on a 30-minute TTL and 2.67 on a 12-hour TTL
svg.desc: Cost of repeating the same 1,024-token prefix, in multiples of one uncached pass. Without caching the cost climbs one unit per pass. A 30-minute write costs 1.25 times input and its line crosses the uncached line at 1.28 passes. A 12-hour write costs 2.50 times input, starts above the uncached line, and only crosses at 2.67 passes, so it needs a third pass to win.
svg.text: A cache write has to berepaid by reuseCost of repeating a 1,024-token prefix
